Rina V: Hey all 64f quick onboarding benefits/payroll questions after week 1: I enrolled in medical + commuter, but I never got a confirmation email for commuter pre-tax. Also I uploaded dependent docs but Status shows 'Pending Verification' 6a7 any idea how long that takes? Finally, I submitted a $260 monitor stand reimbursement 4bb in Expensify last Thu552 when should I expect payment?

Marcus (People Ops): Welcome Rina! :wave: Commuter elections sometimes send a separate confirmation from the commuter vendor within 48h; check spam and the commuter vendor app (link in Benefits portal). Dependent verification usually takes 5-7 business days — if you uploaded ID + SSN it should move faster. If it's still pending after 7 days DM me and we'll escalate.

Rina V: Where do I check the dependent verification docs? Is that in Workday?

Benefits Team: Yes, Workday > Benefits > Documents. The carrier also sends an email if they need additional info. For dependents, please upload birth certificate or marriage certificate + SSN card. If you redacted SSN, upload the SSN page privately to the doc vault.

Payroll Bot: Payroll reminder: Biweekly pay Fridays. Reimbursements flow: People Ops triage (3 business days)  Finance AP runs Tue/Thu; reimbursement will be on the next AP after approval. If Expensify total <= $500 and tagged "newhire-setup" it usually clears on the next AP.

Rina V: I did tag it newhire-setup and amount is $260. It still shows "Pending - Manager Approval" in Expensify. Who approves that? My manager is OOO this week.

Marcus (People Ops): Manager approval is required for > $0 (policy). If manager is OOO, they should delegate in Expensify or you can ask them to approve via mobile app (takes 30s). If it's urgent we can do a manual override for first-week essentials; DM me the Expensify link.

Rina V: Also, if I change my address in Workday will that trigger re-ship for my benefits card? My spouse and I moved recently.

Benefits Team: Update Workday Contact Info first. For re-ship, DM People Ops and include the carrier name; we can request a manual reissue. Note: physical cards are printed weekly by the carrier, e-cards are immediate.

Rina V: Quick payroll math q: will the commuter pre-tax deduction start immediately or wait until the next pay period after carrier activation?

Payroll Bot: Deductions start the first payroll cycle after the carrier confirms enrollment. If carrier activation slips beyond the current payroll run, the deduction starts the following run. You can preview expected deduction amounts in Workday > Pay > Deductions once the enrollment posts.

Rina V: One last thing 4dd holidays and PTO for new hires: do we get the floating holiday pro-rated? I started 2025-09-10.

Marcus (People Ops): Floating holiday is pro-rated based on your start month for that calendar year. Fixed company holidays are not pro-rated; you only receive holiday pay if employed on the holiday date. PTO accrual begins on your start date and accrues monthly pro-rated for partial months.

Finance-bot: Note: If reimbursement is approved before 11:59pm Mon it will hit the Tue AP; otherwise Thu AP.

Rina V: Thanks all, I'll DM Marcus the Expensify link and upload the dependent SSN doc. Appreciate the speedy responses :thumbsup:
